description.it: Per ogni classe di oggi: studenti, lettori del periodo, quota di lettori e prestiti per studente.
description.en: For each class of today: students, readers of the period, share of readers and loans per student.

sql: SELECT pc.class_label AS class, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS students, COUNT(DISTINCT l.patron_id) AS readers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT l.patron_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) AS share, COUNT(l.id) AS loans, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(l.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) AS per_student FROM patron p JOIN patron_class pc ON pc.patron_id = p.id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.patron_id = p.id AND date(l.issued_at) BETWEEN :from AND :to WHERE p.status = 'active' AND p.patron_type = 'student' GROUP BY pc.group_id, pc.level_code ORDER BY MIN(pc.level_position), pc.class_label
